title: fix(client): reconcile the risk dashboard and retire the February 19 cluster
intent: Port RISK-L01, RISK-L02, and RISK-L03 into the February 22 risk dashboard, declare that directory canonical, and remove the superseded February 19 files after the combined behavior is pinned. Axios stays. The dashboard stays unrouted. No CAM authority is added.
behavior_change: syncFiltersToQuery trims the five known query values and omits blanks. One watcher clears the selected bucket on lane, preset, or job edits without a new aggregate request, and clears it and refreshes once when since or until changes. The February 19 view and composables leave production. The five risk endpoints, export bytes, filenames, and JSON-report error text stay the same.

diff_articulation.what_changed: The February 22 filter composable trims query values. RiskDashboardCrossLab.vue watches the five filter refs once, clears the selected bucket, and refreshes only for a date-window change, with an initialization guard so mount issues one aggregate request. The February 19 view, composables, and characterization spec are deleted after their hashes are recorded. The lineage gate accepts a closed reconciliation. The Axios gate keeps the 20-row inventory and expects 18 production importers. Rosette Compare stays unresolved.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #478 withheld canonical status because trimmed queries, selection clearing, and a single date-window refresh were missing. This patch restores those three behaviors in the February 22 view and only then removes the February 19 cluster. It does not add a route, change Axios, or grant manufacturing authority.
